purpose: Teach: グローバリゼーション/投信/空母/プレーオフ/有線/セメント/プランニング/農水省
target_vocab: グローバリゼーション

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、グローバリゼーションの波を乗りこなせ
lines.en: Our company needs to master the wave of globalization.
lines.style: Measured authority, eyes steady. Opening word carries weight. Each clause drops with deliberate finality, no rush. The voice of someone accustomed to being heard.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。退職金は投信での運用も検討します
lines.en: Understood. We're also exploring retirement fund management through investment trusts.
lines.style: Respectful but grounded. Steady cadence, no hedging. Slightly lower in the register than the boss. The tone of a competent second who knows his role.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、空母型の旗艦店を展開しろ
lines.en: We're launching a flagship store network with the scale and visibility of a carrier.
lines.style: Direct, almost architectural in tone. Each phrase lands like a blueprint piece. No softening. The weight of expectation made concrete.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。リーグのプレーオフ時期に合わせて広告を出します
lines.en: Understood. We'll coordinate our advertising push with the league playoff season.
lines.style: Quick acknowledgment, then matter-of-fact. No elaboration beyond what's necessary. The efficiency of someone translating directive into action.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 有線放送のBGMを更新しろ
lines.en: Update the background music rotation on our in-store broadcast system.
lines.style: Clipped, functional delivery. Each word is a task. No inflection for negotiation. The tone of someone moving down a list.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新工場のセメント工事を急ぎます
lines.en: Understood. We'll accelerate the concrete work on the new facility.
lines.style: Quick, confirmatory. Slight lift of agency — this is something Kenji can actually move on. Faster than the previous response, less formal.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、事業プランニングを再検討しろ
lines.en: Our business planning framework needs to be reconsidered from the ground up.
lines.style: Deliberate pause weight on 'reconsidered.' Lower register, heavier. The tone of someone reshuffling the fundamentals. Not a suggestion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。農水省の制度変更に対応します
lines.en: Understood. We'll adapt our operations to align with the Ministry of Agriculture's new regulations.
lines.style: Final confirmation, more formal. Lengthens slightly on 'adapt'—the word carrying the full scope of what's required. Competent close.
